narrative.northStar: Ten distinct worlds, one digital storefront
narrative.overview: Ten independent HTML/CSS/JavaScript storefront studies at /1/ through /10/. Root comparison links all ten. No final selection or Svelte implementation.
keyCharacteristics: Club: graphic cultural posters and condensed lettering.
Première: cinematic covers and editorial serif typography.
Pop: mint and pink interactive product deck with rounded display typography.
Sélection: white and oxblood commerce index with vertical navigation.
Escale: yellow and ultramarine ticket-counter store.
Studio: chocolate and peach record-store browsing.
Objet: lilac and white product gallery.
dos: Do preserve each route's distinct world while the user compares designs.
Do keep illustrative prices and separate payment workflows explicit.
Do retain local imagery, reduced-motion behavior and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't imply that a final design has been selected or that Svelte has been implemented.
Don't introduce gradients, terminal styling, cyberpunk, fabricated reviews, sales counts or guarantees.
